title: Senior Executive Human Resources
description:
**Company Description**
The Shri Ram Academy (TSRA) is a progressive IB school in Hyderabad’s Financial District, where learning is a shared journey between educators and learners. Rooted in the principle of Life Excellence, TSRA focuses on helping students find meaning in their pursuits while nurturing inquiry, reflection, and a global outlook. The school’s culture emphasizes collaboration, creativity, and the joy of learning within safe, empowering spaces. Educators at TSRA are supported to build impactful careers that blend professional growth with purpose, passion, and long-term influence on learners’ lives. Education here extends beyond classrooms, creating a living experience shaped by inspired educators and inquisitive students.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Executive Human Resources will be responsible for overseeing and executing HR operations to support a dynamic educational environment. This full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad includes managing end-to-end HR processes, implementing HR policies, and ensuring compliance with institutional and regulatory standards. Day-to-day responsibilities involve handling employee relations, supporting recruitment and onboarding, maintaining HR documentation, and coordinating performance management and employee engagement initiatives. The role also includes partnering with leadership to align HR strategies with the school’s values, conducting HR analytics and reporting, and supporting training and development programs for academic and non-academic staff. The Senior Executive HR will act as a trusted point of contact for employees, fostering a positive, inclusive, and collaborative workplace culture.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in HR Management and Human Resources (HR) to handle strategic and operational HR functions.
* Candidates should possess experience in HR Operations to manage processes such as recruitment, onboarding, payroll coordination, and HR documentation.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Employee Relations to address staff concerns, support conflict resolution, and promote an inclusive work environment.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of HR Policies to develop, implement, and update policies in line with legal and institutional requirements.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with educators, administrators, and leadership teams.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational and analytical skills, including proficiency in HRIS or similar HR software.
* Candidates should possess a bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; a relevant master’s degree or HR certification is an advantage.
* Candidates should possess prior experience in an educational or service-oriented organization; familiarity with progressive or IB school environments is beneficial.

title: Director of Teacher Operations
description:
**Company Description**

byteXL is an EdTech company focused on transforming engineering colleges in India by modernizing the education system and expanding opportunities for students. The organization partners with colleges and industry to integrate curriculum, content, and hands-on learning, helping students develop in-demand skills and greater employability. By bridging the gap between academia and industry, byteXL aims to shape a new generation of highly skilled professionals who can drive national development. The company envisions a future where every engineering student has access to holistic, industry-relevant education that strengthens both technical capabilities and career readiness.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Director of Teacher Operations to own the quality, consistency, and

performance of our trainer workforce. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for

running the systems to ensure every trainer delivers a consistently excellent learning

experience. In this role you will own quality monitoring and operations- from onboarding and

certification through ongoing monitoring, feedback, and performance management. You will be

the single point of accountability for trainer quality and workforce operations across our

programs.

**What You'll Do**

**Trainer Workforce Management**

Teams you will work with: Sourcing/HR, Learning and development, Ops

* Own end-to-end trainer lifecycle coordination: participate in successful onboarding, be responsible for certification, scheduling, and off-boarding
* Build and manage trainer performance management processes, including for PIPs, recognition programs, and tiering/leveling of trainers
* Flag skill gaps identified through monitoring to the Trainer Development/L&D team for the right coaching or certification interventions (this role identifies the gap and tracks the outcomes)
* Ensure trainers are skilled and ready to meet content delivery needs as needed

**Trainer Quality & Monitoring**

* Responsible for helping evaluate trainer performance, including live session audits, recorded session reviews, and learner feedback analysis
* Maintain rubrics and scorecards for trainer delivery, content accuracy, engagement, and classroom management
* Run a structured cadence of session observations across all trainers and cohorts
* Track and report on trainer quality metrics (session ratings, learner satisfaction, completion rates, escalations) to leadership on a regular cadence
* Identify quality gaps and trends across the trainer pool and drive corrective action plans

**Standards, Compliance & Governance**

* Define and enforce delivery standards, code of conduct, and compliance requirements (including POSH and other statutory training) for all trainers
* Ensure trainers are certified and re-certified on required frameworks, content updates, and compliance modules
* Own audit-readiness for internal and client/accreditation reviews of trainer quality and records
* Investigate and resolve escalations related to trainer conduct, content, or delivery quality

**Systems & Reporting**

* Build dashboards and reporting systems (LMS, CRM, or custom tools) to track trainer quality, attendance, and performance in real time
* Establish feedback loops between learners, program managers, and trainers to close the loop on quality issues quickly

**Cross-functional Leadership**

* Partner with Academic teams to align trainer quality standards with curriculum and learning outcomes
* Partner with Trainer Development/L&D by supplying quality data and gap analysis that informs their coaching, refresher, and certification content
* Build and lead a team of Quality Analysts responsible for session monitoring and trainer coaching
* Represent trainer quality in client/stakeholder reviews where applicable

**What We're Looking For**

* 5-8 years of experience in academic operations, training delivery, or quality assurance, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role managing a trainer/faculty workforce
* Proven experience building or scaling a trainer/teacher quality monitoring function — rubrics, audits, scorecards, or similar QA systems
* Strong background in higher education, EdTech, vocational training, or corporate training environments
* Experience managing large, distributed trainer/faculty pools (in-person, remote, or hybrid)
* Data-driven mindset — comfortable building dashboards, analyzing trends, and making decisions from quality metrics
* Strong people leadership skills, including performance management and coaching at scale
* Familiarity with LMS platforms, session recording/monitoring tools, and reporting systems
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — able to work across academics, operations, compliance, and leadership
* Prior exposure to compliance training frameworks (e.g., POSH) is a plus

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistent, measurable improvement in trainer quality scores and learner satisfaction across cohorts
* A reliable, scalable QA process that catches and corrects quality issues before they affect learners
* Reduced trainer attrition and improved trainer capability through targeted coaching and development
* Clean audit trails and compliance records for all trainer-related governance requirements

title: Global Human Resources Manager
description:
This is a full time role with our global client.

**Role-Global HR Manager**

**Role Purpose**

To manage Business HR, talent acquisition and HR compliance for the organisation’s businesses across North America and Europe, while being based in India. The role will partner with international business leaders to address people-related priorities, support workforce requirements, ensure compliance with local employment regulations, and facilitate effective HR service delivery across multiple countries.

The role will act as a key interface between international business teams, corporate HR in India, and local HR service providers, ensuring that HR practices are aligned with business needs while adhering to country-specific legal and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

A. Business HR (BHR)

* Partner with business leaders across North America and Europe to understand business priorities and address HR-related requirements.
* Provide HR guidance on organisation structure, manpower planning, workforce costs and employee-related matters.
* Support business leaders in managing employee relations, grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace concerns in coordination with local legal and HR experts.
* Facilitate employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, internal movements, changes in employment terms and exits.
* Support organisational changes, restructuring and workforce transitions in line with business requirements and local regulations.
* Drive implementation of corporate HR policies and processes, ensuring appropriate adaptation to local country requirements.
* Act as a bridge between international business teams and the India-based corporate HR function.
* Build relationships with employees and leaders across nationalities, cultures and time zones, demonstrating cultural sensitivity in HR interactions.

B. Talent Acquisition and Hiring

* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and hiring priorities across the assigned regions.
* Manage end-to-end recruitment, including requisition management, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management and onboarding.
* Coordinate with recruitment agencies, search firms and other hiring partners to fulfil business requirements.
* Ensure hiring decisions and processes align with approved manpower budgets, organisational requirements and internal policies.
* Coordinate employment offers, compensation discussions and employment documentation with relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor recruitment timelines, hiring costs, vacancy status and other recruitment metrics.
* Ensure recruitment practices comply with applicable equal employment opportunity, non-discrimination and local hiring requirements.

C. HR Compliance and Employment Regulations

* Coordinate HR compliance across the United States, Canada and relevant European countries.
* Ensure employment documentation, contracts, policies and HR processes comply with applicable local employment laws and regulations.
* Work with local legal counsel, HR consultants and compliance partners on employment terms, working hours, statutory leave, employee exits, disciplinary processes and other employment requirements.
* Monitor changes in employment legislation and coordinate implementation of necessary changes to HR policies and practices.
* Maintain appropriate HR documentation, employee records, compliance trackers and audit-ready information.
* Coordinate statutory and regulatory requirements relating to employee administration, in collaboration with local experts and service providers.
* Support internal and external HR audits and ensure timely closure of identified compliance gaps.
* Ensure appropriate handling of employee information in accordance with applicable data privacy and protection requirements, including GDPR where relevant.

D. HR Operations and External Partner Coordination

* Coordinate HR operational processes across assigned countries, including onboarding, employee documentation, changes in employment status and exits.
* Liaise with local HR representatives, payroll providers, Employer of Record (EOR) partners and external consultants, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with Finance on employee-related costs, manpower budgets, payroll inputs and related reconciliations, as required.
* Monitor service delivery, accuracy and turnaround times for HR processes managed through external partners.
* Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes and strengthen governance across countries.
* Maintain accurate employee data and provide periodic HR reports and dashboards to business and corporate HR leadership.

E. Cross-Cultural and Global Stakeholder Management

* Collaborate with stakeholders across North America, Europe and India, accounting for differences in culture, communication styles and working practices.
* Manage HR matters across different time zones and ensure timely communication and resolution of employee and business requirements.
* Promote consistency in the organisation’s HR approach while recognising country-specific employment practices and cultural nuances.

**Key Stakeholders**

* International business leaders and functional heads
* Corporate HR leadership and Business HR teams in India
* Hiring managers and recruitment partners
* Finance and payroll teams
* Local HR representatives and EOR providers
* External employment lawyers, compliance consultants and statutory service providers

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Typically 7+ years of progressive HR experience, with relevant exposure to international or multi-country HR management.
* Experience in Business HR and talent acquisition within a multinational organisation.
* Working knowledge of employment regulations and HR practices across North America and Europe.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
**About The Corelation**

The Corelation is a boutique talent search firm specialising in mid-to-senior management and senior leadership hiring across industries and functional domains. Our approach is built on tri-axial fitment - a deep alignment between the candidate's profile, the role, and the hiring team. By weighing technical capability and cultural fit with equal rigour, we find professionals who don't just fit in, but outperform.

**About the Opportunity**

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a well-established organisation in the events and conference management space (client name confidential at this stage), for a Human Resources Specialist based in Delhi NCR. This is a broad, hands-on generalist mandate covering the full employee lifecycle - recruitment, employee relations, performance management, benefits and statutory compliance - with direct visibility to management.

Location: Delhi NCR

Employment Type: Full-time, On-site

Experience: 2-5 years

Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration or a related field

**About the Role**

The Human Resources Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring the effective functioning of the organisation's human capital. The role is responsible for a range of HR activities, including recruitment, employee relations, performance management, benefits administration and compliance with labour laws and regulations.

The HR Specialist acts as a liaison between management and employees, fostering a positive work environment and supporting the organisation's strategic objectives. The role contributes to the overall success and effectiveness of the organisation by attracting, retaining and developing top talent.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment and Selection**

• Collaborate with hiring managers to identify staffing needs and develop job descriptions.

• Source and screen candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media and networking.

• Conduct interviews and coordinate the selection process, including reference checks and background screenings.

• Facilitate the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the organisation.

**Employee Relations**

• Serve as a point of contact for employees regarding HR-related inquiries, concerns and grievances.

• Mediate conflicts and facilitate resolution between employees and management.

• Implement employee engagement initiatives to foster a positive work culture and enhance morale.

**Performance Management**

• Administer performance appraisal processes, including goal setting, performance evaluation and feedback sessions.

• Provide guidance and support to managers and employees on performance-related issues.

• Identify training and development needs and coordinate relevant programmes to enhance employee skills and competencies.

**Benefits Administration**

• Administer employee benefits programmes, including health insurance, retirement plans and other perks.

• Assist employees with benefit enrolment, changes and inquiries.

• Collaborate with benefits providers to ensure compliance and resolve issues effectively.

**Compliance and HR Administration**

• Stay up to date with labour laws, regulations and HR best practices.

• Ensure compliance with applicable central and state labour laws and statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity and Shops & Establishments.

• Maintain accurate HR records and documentation to support compliance efforts.

• Prepare HR reports and analytics to support decision-making and strategic planning.

• Assist in developing and updating HR policies, procedures and the employee handbook.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration or a related field.

• 2-5 years of experience in HR roles, preferably in a similar industry.

• Knowledge of HR principles, practices and regulations.

• Strong communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.

• Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• HR certification such as PHR or SHRM-CP.

• Experience supporting a people-facing, project-driven business.

**How to Apply**

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV, along with your current CTC and expected CTC. Applications without these details may not be processed. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by The Corelation for an initial conversation.

**⁠ ⁠Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.**

**⁠ ⁠Problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.**

**⁠ ⁠Ensure timely recruitment against approved manpower requirements.**

**⁠ ⁠Build a stable, motivated and performance-oriented workforce.**

**Company URL: https://porter.in/**

**Role Overview**

We are hiring a Key Account Manager — Porter for Enterprise (PFE) to own, retain, and scale relationships with some of India’s largest enterprise companies. Porter for Enterprise runs managed logistics at scale, and this role requires an individual who will own a portfolio of enterprise accounts like a business owner—ensuring account health, unlocking multi-dimensional revenue growth, and establishing institutionalized operating systems.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Own the client relationship

Be the face of Porter to your accounts — the partner they trust and call first.

● Serve as the single relationship owner for a portfolio of enterprise accounts.

● Engage proactively across every channel the client uses — calls, WhatsApp, email, and in person — rather than waiting for inbound.

● Run a disciplined cadence of reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews that keeps every account close.

● Day-to-day trip and order issues are handled by a dedicated support team. Your focus is the relationship, not the ticket queue.

2. Grow the book

Turn accounts into bigger accounts, and carry the number for it.

● Own upsell and cross-sell across your portfolio against a clear revenue target.

● Expand each account into new cities, new categories, new use cases, and new Departments.

● Map and deepen relationships beyond a single point of contact so growth never depends on one person.

● Build and run a data-backed growth plan for each key account.

3. Drive adoption and self-service

Make your accounts self-sufficient so your time compounds into growth.

● Drive product adoption and enable clients to book, track, and manage their operations themselves.

● Reduce dependence on hand-holding so your effort shifts from servicing to scaling.

4. Own commercial health

Keep the book financially healthy — pricing is dynamic and out of scope.

● Own credit, collections, and payment discipline across your accounts.

● Partner with Finance on credit decisions, exposure, and recovery.

● Handle credit-linked conversations firmly, protecting both the relationship and Porter.

5. Build the system

Make the book run on a system, not on you.

● Decide off data — read your accounts clearly and let the numbers drive the call.

● Develop playbooks for managing large enterprise clients, so the standard lives in the system.

● Document accounts — plans, contacts, cadences — so any account can be run independent of any single person.

● Strong enterprise account management, retention, and relationship-building capabilities.

● Proven track record in carrying and hitting revenue growth targets (upsell/cross-sell).

● Commercial and financial acumen—ability to hold firm conversations around credit, terms, and collections without damaging client partnerships.

● Data fluency—ability to parse metrics, identify operational/revenue trends, and tell actionable stories with data.

● High ownership, proactive outreach habits, and executive communication skills (both in-person presentation and written briefs).

● Playbook and systems-first mindset: preference for designing sustainable operating mechanisms over ad-hoc manual interventions.

**Experience & Eligibility**

● 2–4 years of relevant experience owning client outcomes, targets, and relationships in Key Account Management, B2B/Enterprise Servicing, Logistics, SaaS, or related tech-enabled services.

● Demonstrated track record of consistent growth in account size/revenue book (not just status-quo maintenance).

● Prior experience managing multi-stakeholder relationships and credit/commercial terms in structured B2B environments.

● Willingness and availability to work full-time in-office at the Bangalore Head Office.
